actions.name: Operating System Monitoring
actions.description: The operating system software, for D3FEND's purposes, includes the kernel and its process management functions, hardware drivers, initialization or boot logic. actions.name: Remote File Access Mediation
actions.description: Remote file access mediation is the process of managing and securing access to file systems over a network to ensure that only authorized users or processes can interact with remote files.
actions.reason: Remote File Access Mediation directly secures access to remote files, a key component of managing access control for remote assets.

actions.name: Network Resource Access Mediation
actions.description: Control of access to organizational systems and services by users or processes over a network.

actions.name: Network Access Mediation
actions.description: Network access mediation is the control method for authorizing access to a system by a user (or a process acting on behalf of a user) communicating through a network, including a local area network, a wide area network, and the Internet.
actions.reason: Network Access Mediation authorizes network-based access to systems, ensuring only permitted users interact with remote assets.
